line: Crowley's Nine of Cups is the card for the second decan of Pisces, with Jupiter as its planet in the sign.

sections.title: Crowley's card for this decan
sections.line: Crowley's chapter gives the title and the planet in Pisces.

quotes.quote: The Nine of Cups is called Happiness.
The Ruler is Jupiter in Pisces.

sections.title: What the card is, in his words
sections.line: His description of what the card figures, as the card chapter gives it.

quotes.quote: In this card is the pageant of the culmination and perfection of the original force of Water.
